description: Source file defining the Headers class within the Slim Framework's PSR-7 implementation, managing HTTP headers including adding, removing, retrieving, and validating headers.

classes.name: Headers
classes.description: Implements HeadersInterface to manage HTTP headers in a PSR-7 context, supporting operations like adding, removing, setting, and retrieving headers with proper validation and normalization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Headers object with provided headers and global server variables, setting up internal storage.

methods.name: addHeader
methods.description: Adds a header with specified name and value, appending to existing header list if present.

methods.name: removeHeader
methods.description: Removes a header identified by its name from the internal storage.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the values of a header by name, returning default if not set.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Sets a header to a specified value, replacing existing if present.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Replaces all headers with the provided array of headers.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header exists by name.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all headers, optionally preserving original case.

methods.name: normalizeHeaderName
methods.description: Normalizes header name by replacing underscores, converting to lowercase, and removing 'http-' prefix if present.

methods.name: parseAuthorizationHeader
methods.description: Handles special parsing for Authorization headers, considering server globals.

methods.name: trimHeaderValue
methods.description: Trims whitespace from header values, supporting array or string input.

methods.name: prepareHeader
methods.description: Prepares header data by validating, trimming, and normalizing name and values.

methods.name: validateHeader
methods.description: Validates header name and value for RFC compliance.

methods.name: validateHeaderName
methods.description: Checks if header name matches RFC token pattern.

methods.name: validateHeaderValue
methods.description: Checks if header value is RFC-compatible string or array of strings.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a Headers instance based on PHP global server variables and available headers.
